name: ebb-ai
description: Auto-defer "do it later" work to the cleanest electricity-grid hour. Route any AI request signaled with later / tomorrow / overnight / EOD / remind-me through ebb-ai instead of running immediately. Carbon-aware MCP scheduler + 8 Claude Code slash commands. Apache-2.0.

plugins.name: ebb-ai
plugins.description: Auto-dispatch any "do this later / by tomorrow / overnight / when you have a moment" task to the cleanest grid hour inside the deadline. Invoke when the user defers — queues + scores against live carbon-intensity for 31 grid regions, routes through Anthropic/OpenAI Batch APIs (50% cheaper), writes per-task carbon receipt. Eight slash commands (/ebb-ai:{defer, plan, check, cancel, expedite, reschedule, retry, grid}). Persistent SQLite queue. Apache-2.0.
